proof_steps: Reduction [proved]: scatter side may be replaced by A^T C^T where C^T = A Phi (row M = row C^T is inside row Phi); same gather supports, still exact. So the decoder is a dictionary: directions l_k = columns of A, each root c_b = sum_k x_b(k) l_k, cost sum_k dim span U(A_k).
WLOG A_k = all ports with labels in W_k = span U(A_k) (cost unchanged, availability only grows).
NC_k [proved]: ports usable only with a k-set K of directions have root rank <= k, so the other m-k directions' port sets cover the complement of a rank-k flat.
